comment: Ground truth for the bases stage. Board mm, base bottom diameter. rim 'clear': at least half of the rim is visible, the single-frame test needs it within 2 mm and with the right size. rim 'hidden': a model, a wall or a token hides most of the rim; position approximate (tol_mm), checked only with an empty-board reference. diameter_mm null: size not known.
